maria: quick async — wedge preflight for Fri deploy. canaries start 09:00 PST, tiny slice (0.5%). TLDR: routing, KV cache, and ff gating. please post status here. :rocket:
sam: acked. I updated the rollout plan doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/wedge-preflight — added surge params and expected latencies. :eyes:
devin: re: routing — I rolled out the new fallback policy to slice-0 earlier today. observed <10ms added p95 in lab. will watch during ramp.
ana: (QA) running the smoke suite now against canary variant. found one flaky test in reranker. filing bug shortly.
marIA: @ana thanks — ping me the bug id when you have it, will triage priority.
sam: CR reminder — please review #589 (inference routing changes). blocking if not merged before 08:00. @devin @tony
tony: reviewing now, aim to approve by 07:45. one nit on the comments but not blocking.
ana: bug: https://tracker.internal/bugs/4321 — fails when prompt includes non-ascii, fallback to legacy reranker. assigning to @devin.
devin: acked bug 4321. I can repro locally, will push a patch by 06:30.
maria: ops question — are capacity buffers set for dedicated pools? we want +10% buffer for wedge.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 2026-03-20T09:00:00-08:00 for wedge-rollout (slice-0). instances: 2 -> 4.
sam: buffer noted. I set autoscale min to reserve +12% for dedicated pools in us-west.
maria: final checks for everyone: 1) CR merged, 2) QA smoke green, 3) rollout flags ready. reply with short "ok" when done. :white_check_mark:
tony: ok (CR approved).
devin: ok (patch pushed).
ana: smoke suite passing on canary variant, 1 non-blocking flaky noted and tracked. ok.
sam: flags wired, autoscale set. ok.
maria: thanks team — will flip the preflight flag at 08:50 and start canary at 09:00. leaving this thread open for live pings. :thumbsup:
